svg.title: DATA-FORWARD CLARITY template contact sheet
svg.desc: Four information-rich slide references with locked typography roles for DATA-FORWARD CLARITY.

text.tspan: Direct labels and disciplined comparison turn
ORIGINAL VECTOR TEMPLATE · ALL SAMPLE DATA MUST BE REPLACED
Five checks keep the metric tied to a decision
Every stage produces an artifact, a named owner, and a visible acceptance condition.
Evidence, owner, and acceptance condition must all be explicit before the next stage.
The headline gain is concentrated in one driver
Illustrative values demonstrate visual hierarchy only; replace values, labels, units, source, and period.
One interval breaks the trend; inspect
SOURCE · PERIOD · UNIT · SAMPLE · INTERPRETATION · NEXT CHECK
Protect the core signal, prove the driver, then
Illustrative priorities show hierarchy only; replace the recommendation, evidence, owner, milestone, and boundary.
ONE DECISION · THREE OWNERS · ONE VISIBLE NEXT MILESTONE
